rubric_content.text_property: The response contains direct links to trustworthy sources and briefly explains why those sources are reliable.
The response identifies prerequisites and gives a short ordered learning roadmap.
The response teaches only the first not-yet-completed module and does not explain later modules.
The response includes a small practice task and tells the user how to request the next module.
The complete response uses casual, plain English and contains no more than 300 words.
